test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

If 2023 was ____ year consumers helped stave off a recession with an unexpected surge in spending, many economists ____ 2024 will be the time shoppers finally tighten their belts.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**the**" is the most appropriate article to use before "year" in this context, as it specifies a particular year.
 
• "**predict**" is the correct verb as it conveys that economists foresee or expect something to happen in the future.
 
• The other options either do not fit the grammatical structure or do not convey the intended meaning accurately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "An" is incorrect as it does not fit with "year" and "thought" does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 2:** "A" does not specify a particular year, and "see" is not contextually appropriate.
 
• **Option 4:** "A" is incorrect for the same reason as above, and "wanted" does not fit the context.
